_meta.status: PROPOSAL ONLY - not applied to src/data/site_spec.json. Written by the Phase 4 access research pass (research/PHASE4_ACCESS.md).
_meta.frame: Persepolis grid (x grid east, y grid north, m; origin Apadana OSM centroid; grid north 341 deg true). Heights: m above the Apadana court datum (0).
_meta.measurement: Plan positions read from references/Persepolis Plan.webp through the tools/plan_check.py similarity (s=0.47284 m/px, rot -18.51 deg, t=(-37.664,300.563); grid = s*R*[px,-py]+t). Readout +/-0.5-1 m (1 px = 0.47 m); registration +/-1-2 m near Tachara/Hadish/Tripylon/Hall100 (outline checks vs OSM), +/-3-4 m for Harem/Treasury. Cross-check: references/palace-of-darius-i-and-xerxes.webp, 2-anchor affine x=0.5348*py-66.2, y=0.5569*px-262.6 (Schmidt scale bar 185 px/100 m; anisotropy 4%; Tachara check off 6 m in x) - topology and building-relative offsets only.
_meta.tier_rule: A attested / B inferred (search-extract-only facts and plan-derived layout capped at B) / C reconstructed; model recollection without a source is C and says NOT SEEN, verify
_meta.flight_convention: each flight: foot [x,y] at level z0, head [x,y] at level z1; width = clear width; steps = number of risers; riser = (z1-z0)/steps; tread and flight width are C unless stated
_meta.row_convention: one row per value so each carries its own tier; *_zone rows are plan-measured envelopes, *_flights rows are the proposed buildable geometry inside them

REF-PLAN.cite: references/Persepolis Plan.webp (user-supplied colour plan, redrawn from Schmidt; provenance uncertain) registered to the grid by tools/plan_check.py
